reviews.title: AS2 Wave 6 genuine HTML5/WASM runtime conformance promotions
reviews.summary: Promote 76 AS2 declarations whose main runtime behavior is genuinely implemented and verified in Rust/WASM and the HTML5 host (ContextMenu/ContextMenuItem, Stage layout, DisplacementMapFilter live rendering, MovieClipLoader/loadMovie/getBytesLoaded, Sound.loadSound, Video.smoothing, LocalConnection, PrintJob); keep 217 OS/server/Saffron-bounded entries partial.
